'''Kanzin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Kanzin appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a vendor on the Imperial fleet.<ref name="SWTOR" />
